decisions.reason: As the next-generation replacement in a proven voltage-measurement line, it likely continues to meet aspiration levels relative to its predecessor and comparable core modules, so we keep it.

The MQTT proxy still supports the platform’s connectivity logic at low carrying cost, but after several years its standalone adoption may be modest enough to create some aspiration risk, so we keep it while accepting a meaningful withdrawal possibility.

The CO2 sensor remains strategically aligned with the firm’s sensing portfolio and likely performs better than the broader indoor-air module that was already dropped, so we keep it unless demand clearly falls short of aspiration.
